settings.title: Settings
settings.invalidNumber: "{name}" must be a whole number of at least {min}

registration_enabled.label: Public registration
registration_enabled.description: Allow anyone to create an account from the registration page.

max_concurrent.label: Max concurrent downloads
max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of downloads running at the same time.

lyrics_enabled.label: Lyrics download
lyrics_enabled.description: Automatically fetch lyrics from LRCLIB for every downloaded track.

synced_lyrics_only.label: Synced lyrics only
synced_lyrics_only.description: Only keep time-synced lyrics; plain (unsynced) lyrics are rejected and retried later.

charts_enabled.label: Charts
charts_enabled.description: Enable the Charts page and chart subscriptions.

sync_interval_hours.label: Artist sync interval (hours)
sync_interval_hours.description: How often each followed artist is checked for new releases.

job_cleanup_days.label: Job retention (days)
job_cleanup_days.description: Completed jobs older than this are deleted. Failed jobs are kept.

token_cleanup_days.label: Token cleanup interval (days)
token_cleanup_days.description: How often expired sign-in tokens are purged from the database.

lyrics_retry_interval_hours.label: Lyrics retry interval (hours)
lyrics_retry_interval_hours.description: How often tracks with missing or unsynced lyrics are retried.

chart_sync_interval_hours.label: Chart sync interval (hours)
chart_sync_interval_hours.description: How often each followed chart is re-fetched to follow new top-N artists.

language.label: YouTube Music language
language.description: Language of the data fetched from YouTube Music (artist bios, album descriptions, …).

settings.cleanupDescription: Remove orphaned tracks, albums, and artists that are no longer associated with any subscription.

users.confirmDelete: Delete user "{username}"? This action cannot be undone.

charts.syncDisabledHint: Enable the chart to sync it
charts.previewFollowing: Following the top {n} of {total} artists. Followed artists are marked with a check.

confirm.unfollow: Stop following the {country} chart? Artists already followed from it stay followed.
confirm.disable: Disable the {country} chart? It will no longer be re-synced and will be hidden from the Charts page. Followed artists are unaffected.
confirm.enable: Enable the {country} chart? It will be re-synced periodically and shown on the Charts page again.
confirm.topNIncrease: Follow the top {to} artists of the {country} chart instead of the top {from}? A sync is queued right away and the additional artists are followed with their full discography.
confirm.topNDecrease: Follow the top {to} artists of the {country} chart instead of the top {from}? Artists already followed stay followed.
confirm.sync: Sync the {country} chart now? Any of its top {n} artists not followed yet will be followed with their full discography.
